knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The national guidance places personal protective equipment at the bottom of the control order and warns against using it by itself. Engineering controls come first.
The national guidance recommends the quantitative method for full face respirators and powered air purifying respirators. Qualitative testing is for half-face respirators only.
The national guidance expects monitoring to begin as soon as a worker takes on silica work, including at hire, so that early changes in health are picked up.
A fit test is specific to the model and size. The national guidance calls for a fit test when a new make or model is issued, so the worker is tested on the new model before wearing it.
The NT guide names AS/NZS 1716:2012 and AS/NZS 1715:2009 for the Northern Territory. They are confirmed for the local state before they are stated as a requirement.

practicalCriteria: Confirms a current fit test for the model and size before a dusty task, from the provider's record
Carries out a user seal check each time the respirator is put on, following the manufacturer's directions
Confirms that the health monitoring arrangement, where the risk requires one, is on file before the dusty task starts
Refuses a dusty task where training, fit testing or the monitoring arrangement is missing, and records the stop
passRule: Knowledge checks: 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate and is not granted by the knowledge check: an assessor must observe every practical criterion and record it. A reading or quiz pass is never presented as verified practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Respirator selection record linked to the risk assessment, with model, class and filter
Fit-test record with date, model, size and provider
Health monitoring arrangement on file, or a written note that the risk assessment did not require one
stopWorkCriteria: Tight-fitting respirator worn without a current fit test for the model and size
Training or health monitoring arrangement missing for a dusty task where the risk requires it
A respirator model changed without a new fit test
